official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: timestamped DTM archive includes surveys since 1998
data are GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files
vertical reference is Ordnance Survey Newlyn
data are aligned to OS Grid
transformation is specific to survey time period
metadata catalogue records survey date resolution transformation and geoidal model
quality_effect: Requires survey epoch, resolution and vertical transformation metadata to accompany candidate elevations.
